title: The genealogical, structural and functional projections

statements.text: The genealogical projection is that an entity has the specific causal history that produced its specific activity. The structural projection is that it holds together as one entity across time. The functional projection is that the activity is what the entity is being, not something it has or does in addition. Each is read through its own witness regime.

sources.quote: Genealogical projection: an entity has the specific causal history that produced its specific activity.
Structural projection: an entity holds together as one entity across time.
Functional projection: the activity is what the entity is being.
